basic_details.job_title: CMRL General Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The one post of General Manager (Operations) at Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL), a Joint Venture of Government of India and Government of Tamil Nadu, is on Regular basis with IDA-pattern pay of Rs.1,20,000 - 2,80,000 a month, plus DA, HRA (30% of Basic Pay) and Cafeteria Allowance (31.5% of Basic Pay). Applicants must be a B.E / B.Tech or any Graduate, and the experience required depends on whether they come from a Government organisation, a Metro / PSU or the private sector. Applications are accepted only online at careers.chennaimetrorail.org on or before 15-12-2026, under Employment Notif

how_to_apply: Apply only online on the CMRL website, careers section, at https://careers.chennaimetrorail.org/.
Register on the CMRL Career portal with a valid email id. This email id is the only one used for further correspondence.
Click the verify button in the registration link sent to the registered email id. You are then redirected to the CMRL career page to log in and apply.
Fill all details in each section and upload the requisite documents as per the notification.
Pay the application fee through online / electronic mode and upload the NEFT/UPI payment receipt in the online form.
Submit the online application with documents on or before 15-12-2026.

Only candidates who give relevant experience details in the Professional experience (Area of work) section of the online form are considered for scrutiny. Self-attested copies of degree, mark sheet and the experience certificate of the latest position should show the detail, nature and function of the job presently handled. No hard copy / paper application is entertained, and candidates are advised not to send any hard copy to the office. For help with the online application, call 044-24378000 on working days between 10:00 a.m. and 6.00 p.m. Email queries may be sent to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About CMRL
content_sections.text: Chennai Metro Rail Limited, with its office at Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai - 600 035, is a Joint Venture of Government of India and Government of Tamil Nadu. In the notice it is described as a special purpose vehicle (SPV) entrusted with implementing the Metro Rail Project in the city of Chennai.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: B. E / B. Tech or any Graduate from a Govt recognized Institute / University, approved by AICTE / UGC. Only Indian Nationals need to apply. Experience required, by type of applicant: Applicant from Govt Organization: Group A Officer from Railways working in Senior Administrative Grade (SAG) / Non-Functional Senior Administrative Grade (NF-SAG) / Equivalent in GoI, having sufficient experience in Train operations. Applicant from Metros / PSUs Organization: minimum 20 years of post qualification executive experience and at least 3 years as AGM in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 100000 - 260000 or equivalent pay. Applicant from Private Sector: minimum 20 years of post qualification executive experience and at least 03 years in top management positions (equivalent to AGM in PSU), reporting directly to a Director or Board. Applicant from Private Sector must also have worked in companies where the project size is not less than Rs.500 Crore, or a company with an annual turnover of not less than Rs.100 Crore in the last 3 years. Documentary proof of project size / turnover is to be uploaded online while applying. All applicants: experience in Operations & Maintenance in Railways / Metro or experience in related field. Experience in UTO will be preferred. The maximum age is 55 years, counted as on 25-11-2026. The notice also states that no person is eligible for direct recruitment unless he has completed 18 years of age on the date of Notification. The notice adds that age may be relaxed for deserving and experienced candidates. In all cases of age relaxation, the maximum age limit, taking into benefit cumulative age relaxation, shall not exceed 58 years as on date of notification. Reservation of the post will be followed as per Government of Tamil Nadu guidelines. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The scale of pay (IDA pattern) is Rs.1,20,000 - 2,80,000 per month. Apart from the Basic Pay, DA (IDA pattern), HRA (30% of Basic Pay), Cafeteria Allowance (31.5% of Basic Pay) and other benefits are paid. These include Perks, Medical benefit, EPF, Gratuity and insurance etc., as per extant rules of HR Manual, CMRL. The post is on Regular basis. Selected candidates are on probation for one year. Confirmation is solely based on performance and successful completion of probation. CMRL can terminate service during probation if performance is found unsatisfactory, in accordance with the terms of the offer of appointment. One year relaxation in the residency period in next below scale will be considered for internal candidates.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is a two-stage process: interview followed by a medical examination. It judges candidates on knowledge, skills, comprehension, attitude, aptitude and physical fitness. Scrutiny of applications for shortlisting is based solely on the documents and certificates uploaded online. Merely meeting the qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be selected for interview. Only short-listed candidates will be notified for interview, and CMRL reserves the right to shortlist. Eligibility is provisional and is verified only for shortlisted candidates. Expenses for the first-time medical examination are borne by CMRL. If a candidate seeks extension for joining, the second medical examination is at the candidate's expense. To and fro travel expenses for the medical test are borne by the candidate. A candidate who fails the prescribed medical test will not be given alternative employment. Provisionally selected candidates will be intimated to appear for original certificates verification and medical examination. Success in selection confers no right to appointment unless CMRL is satisfied about the candidate's character and antecedents.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Persons already working in Government / PSU organization should apply through proper channel to [email protected] and produce NOC at the time of interview. Private sector applicants must mention their designation against each organization worked in, and enclose the organizational chart showing their level. No TA / DA will be paid by CMRL to candidates for attending the interview. CMRL reserves the right to withdraw the post at any time, to fill it in the same position or at a lower position, or not to fill it. It may also cancel, curtail or increase the number of vacancies. The management reserves the right to increase or relax the eligibility standards depending on the response. Acceptance or rejection of applications is at its sole discretion. Candidates who attempt to influence or interfere with the selection process will be rejected summarily and declared disqualified for future CMRL recruitments. If incorrect or false information, suppressed facts or fake documents are detected at any stage, the candidature is liable to be rejected. If detected after appointment, services will be terminated without notice. All recruitment information will be published only on https://chennaimetrorail.org/ .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 vacancy, for the post of General Manager (Operations), on Regular basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CMRL General Manager (Operations) post?
faq.answer: The online application with the requisite documents must be submitted on or before 15-12-2026. The notice prints no time for the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CMRL General Manager (Operations)?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a B. E / B. Tech or any Graduate from a Govt recognized Institute / University, approved by AICTE / UGC, with the experience set out for their sector.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required?
faq.answer: Government applicants need to be a Group A Railway officer in SAG / NF-SAG / equivalent in GoI. Metro / PSU and private sector applicants need a minimum of 20 years of post qualification executive experience, plus 3 years at AGM level or in top management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years as on 25-11-2026. SC/SC (Arunthathiyars)/ST get 5 years and MBC/DC and BC categories get 2 years of relaxation, while the cumulative age limit shall not exceed 58 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of CMRL General Manager (Operations)?
faq.answer: The scale of pay (IDA pattern) is Rs.1,20,000 - 2,80,000 per month. DA, HRA (30% of Basic Pay), Cafeteria Allowance (31.5% of Basic Pay) and other benefits are paid apart from the Basic Pay.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.300/- for Unreserved and other category candidates and Rs.50/- for SC/ST. Differently Abled persons pay no fee, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Apply only online at the CMRL careers portal, https://careers.chennaimetrorail.org/. Hard copy applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is a two-stage process of an interview followed by a medical examination. Only shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent post and does CMRL pay TA/DA for the interview?
faq.answer: The post is on Regular basis with a one-year probation. CMRL will not pay TA / DA to candidates for attending the interview.
